title: The Fire Tiger's Full Moon Birthday
skyStory: Spring has arrived, the Fire Tiger turns forty-one, and the full moon rises in Virgo at ninety-nine percent to make it official. Mars throws open every window in the solar system. Saturn, gruff as ever, has baked a lopsided cake and is pretending he did not. The Sun, reborn into Aries, lights forty-one candles in the sky. Even the snowbanks are melting just to make room for the party.

reading: Happy birthday, Fire Tiger. You were born on the hinge of the year, the day the light wins, and today it wins for you. The full moon is shining on your exact birthday for the first time in years, and it brought friends: every star you have ever wished on is back to say they remember.

Today [[The Sun]] card is standing upright for once, no reversal, no lesson, just warm light pouring over you. Your only job is to receive it. Every compliment, every message, every slice of cake. No deflecting. No saying you do not need anything. Switch the onyx to your right wrist at sunset to send that light straight back to Nancy, and watch for the moment she feels it.
joel.mission: Receive every single birthday wish today with only the words thank you, I love that, and let it land.
joel.omen: Forty-one of anything: steps, cars, minutes past the hour. It means the universe is counting with you and cheering.

reading: Today is his day, and you are the co-host. The mountain stands back and lets the fire blaze, which is one of the most generous things a mountain can do. Your ruby will feel warm all day long, like it knows exactly whose birthday it is.

At moonrise, take the ruby off your pinky and set it in the moonlight beside something dark and steady to stand in for his onyx. The Full Moon Recharge. Here is the part you will not believe: at that exact moment, Joel will be switching his onyx to his right wrist, sending light back across the water to you. Don't even scream. The universe planned it, and so, quietly, did you.
nancy.mission: At moonrise, set your ruby in the moonlight for five minutes, then put it back on and text Joel happy birthday, Tiger.
nancy.omen: The full moon caught in bare branches for a moment, then breaking free. The light you two share just got a fresh charge.

together.text: Full Moon Recharge on the birthday equinox. At moonrise, ruby and onyx go into the moonlight together, his wrist switches, her stone glows. Compare the exact minute you each did it. If they match, say DES out loud and laugh until spring arrives completely.

game.intro: Happy birthday, Fire Tiger! Full moon, equinox, DES. Saturn baked a number. Don't go over it.
game.question: The Knight of Wands has siblings. How many Wands cards are in a standard tarot deck, Ace through King?
